claims.sentence: You must submit your application and supporting documents no later than one month before the University's established start date of the academic year
You submit your personal application to the University's structural subdivision responsible for admissions, addressed to the University Director
You must present a document verifying your identity when you submit the application
Along with the application, you attach the following documents
A copy of your education document or education and qualification document

A copy of a certificate (or copies of certificates) of your study period, confirming successful completion of previous intermediate assessments at other educational organizations, if you are studying in the form of self-education
Any other documents whose submission serves your interests as a person wishing to be enrolled as an extern
When submitting the application, you also sign a consent for the processing of personal data in accordance with the requirements of Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data"
Based on this consent, the University has the right to enter information about you as an extern into federal, regional, and municipal information systems
The University's Attestation Commission makes the decision on your enrollment based on the documents you submit
The Commission's decision is formalized in a protocol

On the basis of the Attestation Commission's protocol, the University signs a contract for paid educational services with you as an extern and issues an order enrolling you to pass the intermediate and final state assessments
The evidence does not specify the exact address or contact details of the admissions subdivision
It does not state the deadline for the Attestation Commission to issue its protocol after receiving the documents
It does not specify the cost, payment terms, or duration of the paid educational services contract
It does not indicate whether the application can be submitted online or only in person
It does not clarify what happens if the Attestation Commission denies the application
It does not state whether the 3x4 cm photo must be recent or meet specific quality standards
